overview.title: Admission
overview.intro: Everything you need to know to take the first step towards Loretto Central School.

steps.title: Send an enquiry
steps.body: Tell us a little about your child and the class you are interested in. Our admissions team will get in touch.

steps.title: Talk with our team
steps.body: We will help you understand availability, the school day and the documents needed for your application.

steps.title: Meet the school
steps.body: Arrange a visit and learn more about the campus, our approach and the Loretto community.

steps.title: Complete your application
steps.body: If a place is available, our team will guide you through the formal application and next steps.

overview.policyText:
Admission is subject to class availability and the school’s age and eligibility criteria. Please contact the admissions office for the current prospectus, fee schedule, required documents and dates.

Submitting an enquiry is not an admission application or confirmation of a place. Our team will contact you to explain the process for your child’s class.
